entries.intent: Rendere percepibile stato, esito o errore senza affidarsi al solo colore.
entries.pvipBinding: Visual expression is product-specific; each listed product retains its governed PVIP.
entries.semanticContract: Semantic status/alert chosen according to urgency; message remains understandable as text.
accessibility: Text conveys meaning without color alone
Announcements do not steal focus unnecessarily

content.resilience: Long text wraps and remains complete

privacyTrust.sanitisation: Rendered external/user content must be treated as untrusted

composition.cardinality: Exactly one message; at most one recovery action by default
composition.nestingConstraints: Must not contain another status message
composition.responsibilities: Parent selects urgency and placement; component owns semantic announcement

entries.intent: Preservare agency umana in una decisione con esito esplicito e recuperabile.
entries.pvipBinding: Each listed product retains its governed PVIP.
entries.semanticContract: Review context precedes decision controls; confirmation is perceptible and names the resulting state.
entries.keyboardFocus: Logical source order; focus remains predictable after validation, success and failure.
accessibility: Decision controls have explicit accessible names
Confirmation does not rely on transient visual-only feedback

responsive.M: Single or split view preserving source order
responsive.L: Context and decision may use split view
responsive.LIM: No hidden decision context or horizontal dependency

content.resilience: Missing optional metadata does not block core decision
content.empty: No decision action without reviewable subject

feedback.perceptibleOutcome: Persistent or sufficiently durable confirmation names action, target and resulting state; errors provide recovery.

privacyTrust.dataClass: Uses only data authorized by governing product contracts
privacyTrust.sanitisation: Untrusted material is isolated/sanitised before rendering

composition.cardinality: One decision context; one primary decision group; one outcome region
composition.nestingConstraints: No nested competing primary decision flow
composition.responsibilities: Parent supplies authoritative context and concurrency token; pattern owns task order and perceptible outcome
